name: The Famous "Clean the Sink" Ice Cream Challenge
whyItWorks: Served in an actual miniature kitchen sink with 6 giant scoops of ice cream, 3 toppings, bananas, whole crushed nuts, whipped cream, and cherries. It represents a massive barrage of lactose, sugar, nuts, and fat.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Severe Flare Hazard: Do not attempt under any circumstances if you have Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis. Severe cramping, obstruction risk from nuts, and diarrhea will follow.
